```{r}
data <- read.csv("data/students.csv")
summary(data)
```


```{r}
## imput tidyverse formule
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
data %>% ## add table 
  summarise_if(is.numeric, list( ##numeric
    mean = mean,
    sd = sd,
    median = median,
    quantile = quantile,
    min = min,
    max = max
  ), na.rm = TRUE) ## skip the missing values
```


```{r}
## the summary is different from one column to the next because the column with not the same type of character
```
```{r}
summary(data)
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)

students <- read_csv("data/students.csv")

# Histogramme de la variable Weight
ggplot(students, aes(x = Weight)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2.5, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Histogram of Weight", x = "Weight (kg)", y = "Count")
```
